title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer

title: Consultor Sênior ServiceNow – ITSM (Trusted Advisor / PO)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa para atuar com ServiceNow em um de nossos clientes do segmento de Varejo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar como Trusted Advisor do cliente, compreendendo profundamente as necessidades do negócio e traduzindo-as em demandas claras para os times técnicos;
  • Ser a ponte entre a área de negócio e a área técnica , garantindo alinhamento contínuo entre expectativas, soluções e entregas;
  • Apoiar na definição da estratégia de implementação e evolução do ServiceNow, com foco no módulo ITSM ;
  • Atuar na descoberta, refinamento e priorização de demandas , com postura consultiva e visão de valor para o negócio;
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de desenvolvimento , garantindo aderência aos requisitos definidos, prazos e qualidade das entregas;
  • Apoiar discussões de arquitetura funcional (sem papel de arquiteto), assegurando boas práticas e aderência ao framework ServiceNow;
  • Facilitar reuniões com stakeholders, como alinhamentos, refinamentos, status reports e apresentações executivas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, automação e otimização de processos dentro da plataforma;
  • Atuar de forma próxima ao cliente, com postura de PO/Consultor Funcional , orientado a valor e resultado.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida como Consultor(a) ServiceNow , com foco no módulo ITSM ;
  • Vivência atuando como interface entre negócio e tecnologia ;
  • Experiência em levantamento e gestão de requisitos, backlog e demandas evolutivas;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis de stakeholders (técnico e executivo);
  • Visão estratégica e analítica para propor soluções alinhadas ao negócio;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos e com múltiplos times envolvidos.

Você se destacará, se tiver:

  • Conhecimento em Soluções Servicenow em diversos módulos
  • Certificação no módulo de ITSM (opcional)
  • Experiencia com Portal, frameworks de front-end como react ou angular

title: PRA Engineer
description:
Job Title: PRA Engineer

Department: Identity and Access Management (IAM)

Sub-Domain: Beyond Trust PRA


Job Summary

The PRA Engineer is responsible for implementing, managing, and maintaining BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) solutions to ensure secure and compliant privileged access across enterprise systems. This role supports operational health checks, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of PAM processes in alignment with organizational security standards.


Key Responsibilities

· Configure, deploy, and maintain BeyondTrust PRA platform for secure remote access.

· Monitor and manage privileged sessions to prevent unauthorized access.

· Perform regular health checks, patching, and system maintenance for PRA components.

· Troubleshoot issues related to PRA connectivity, authentication, and session management.

· Collaborate with IAM and security teams to enforce compliance with access policies.

· Document operational procedures, SOPs, and ensure adherence to SLAs.

· Support audits and provide evidence for regulatory compliance.


Required Skills & Qualifications

· Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles.

· Hands-on experience with BeyondTrust PRA or similar PAM tools.

· Knowledge of security protocols (SSL/TLS, MFA, VPN) and operational best practices.

· Familiarity with Windows/Linux administration and networking fundamentals.

· Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.


Preferred Qualifications

· Certifications in BeyondTrust, PAM, or IAM technologies.

· Experience in enterprise security operations and compliance frameworks.


Equality & Opportunity for All

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack - Plataforma SaaS para Saúde Animal


Remoto (Brasil) | Contrato com possibilidade de efetivação


Sobre o projeto:

Plataforma SaaS para médicos veterinários autônomos com IA integrada. Já temos algumas funcionalidades construídas mas precisamos acrescentar, refinar e preparar para lançamento.

Você trabalhará com a fundadora que está envolvida no desenvolvimento técnico.


O Que Você Fará:

Primeiros 3 meses:

Auditar e refinar código existente para produção

Trabalhar com aspectos de inovação da plataforma

Implementar segurança e conformidade LGPD

Otimizar integração com IA

Preparar infraestrutura de deploy


Depois:

Desenvolver novas funcionalidades

Implementar testes e CI/CD

Colaborar em decisões técnicas

Documentar sistemas


Requisitos Técnicos:

Backend (Node.js, Python ou similar)

Frontend (React ou Vue.js)

Bancos SQL e NoSQL

APIs RESTful e integrações

Experiência com APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic)

Git


Diferenciais:

Experiência com software de saúde

LGPD e prescrição eletrônica

WhatsApp Business API

SaaS multi-tenant

Trabalho em startups.


O Que Procuramos:

Código limpo e manutenível

Equilibra qualidade com entrega.

Comunica claramente.

Trabalha de forma colaborativa.

Assume responsabilidade end-to-end.


Oferecemos:

Trabalho remoto flexível

Impacto real no setor de saúde animal

Tecnologia de ponta (IA)

Potencial de crescimento técnico

Possibilidade de equity


Como Se Candidatar:

Envie para:

Por que te interessa (3-4 frases)

Portfolio (2-3 projetos relevantes)

Responda as seguintes perguntas:


1) Você está entrando em um projeto onde uma fundadora técnica construiu funcionalidades que funcionam, mas o código precisa ser refinado para produção. Descreva sua abordagem para a primeira semana - o que você olharia primeiro, que perguntas faria, e como priorizaria o que precisa ser corrigido?


2) Considerando uma aplicação React Native que precisa integrar APIs de LLM (como OpenAI ou Anthropic) para oferecer suporte de decisão clínica em tempo real, como você arquitetaria essa integração? Quais seriam suas principais preocupações com performance, gerenciamento de estado, e experiência do usuário em dispositivos móveis?\"


3) Esta plataforma lida com dados sensíveis de saúde e precisa estar em conformidade com a LGPD para prescrições veterinárias no Brasil. Quais seriam as primeiras 3-5 considerações de segurança ou conformidade que você abordaria antes do lançamento?


Remuneração competitiva baseada em experiência.

title: Analista Fiscal - Departamento Fiscal
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Salus Contabilidade é um escritório localizado em Chapecó (SC), especializado em serviços contábeis e tributários descomplicados e personalizados, com foco em abertura de empresas, gestão financeira e atendimento ágil.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Analista Fiscal para integrar nossa equipe em Chapecó, SC. As principais responsabilidades incluem acompanhar e realizar atividades relacionadas a apuração de impostos, elaborar relatórios fiscais, realizar análises tributárias e assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e acessórias. O cargo requer busca constante por melhorias nos processos fiscais. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e presencial.


Qualificações

  • Operacional : Habilidade de escrituração, lançamento e importação de Notas Fiscais, prestar atendimento resolutivo a questões apresentadas pelos clientes.
  • Impostos : Experiência em cálculo e apuração de impostos, incluindo tributos diversos e tributos indiretos como impostos de consumo.
  • Habilidades Analíticas : Capacidade de realizar análises tributárias detalhadas para identificar conformidades e oportunidades.
  • Adicionalmente , qualificações como graduação em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas relacionadas, conhecimento em legislação tributária (municipal, estadual e federal) e experiência no sistemas de Escrituração Fiscal Questor serão considerados diferenciais.


  • Salário conforme conhecimento, experiência e habilidades;
  • Plano de cargos e salários
  • Vale alimentação
  • Day off


Vaga é exclusivamente presencial, portanto residir em Chapecó se torna indispensável.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that ensure the quality, reliability, and continuous delivery of network and software services. This role focuses on developing robust automated test solutions, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines, and driving end-to-end test coverage across web, API, and network layers. The ideal candidate combines strong automation expertise with modern DevOps practices and familiarity with AI-enabled full-stack development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, reusable automated test frameworks for network and software systems.
  • Implement and maintain automation for web, API, and network layers.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and Xray to validate APIs, software components, and end-to-end service workflows.
  • Develop scalable automation solutions to support continuous delivery and high-quality releases.
  • Monitor automation pipelines, analyze failures, and maintain regression test suites to ensure system stability.
  • Collaborate with network engineers, developers, and DevOps teams to embed quality into the development lifecycle.
  • Leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance automation, testing, and application workflows where applicable.


Required Technical Skills

  • Python
  • Jinja2
  • YANG models for network automation and validation
  • Robot Framework / Pytest
  • Understanding of typing and data modeling
  • Test case design and behavior-driven development (BDD)
  • CI/CD pipeline integration
  • Git-based source control management
  • Pipeline monitoring, reporting, and regression management
  • Familiarity with AI tools and frameworks is beneficial
  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications is beneficial

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.



Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: SAP APO Deployment Support Consultant
description:
This is a remote position to work from LATAM collaborating with US clients.


We offer:

  • 100% Remote Work
  • $28 USD per hour


Title: SAP APO Deployment Support Consultant

Responsible for supporting and optimizing the SAP APO Deployment module to ensure efficient product distribution across the supply network. This role focuses on resolving planning run issues, managing the transition from supply plans to transport orders, and maintaining the integrity of the Core Interface (CIF).


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP APO, with at least one end-to-end implementation and extensive support experience in SNP/Deployment.
  • Technical Proficiency:
  • Expert knowledge of SNP Deployment and TLB functionalities.
  • Strong understanding of CIF integration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with other APO modules (DP, GATP, or PP/DS) is highly preferred.
  • Integration Knowledge: Experience integrating SAP APO with SAP ERP (ECC 6.0 or S/4HANA) and SAP BW.
  • Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills to debug complex planning issues and propose system enhancements.

title: Blockchain / Tokenization Engineering Manager Director
description:
I’m helping RMD International Group find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Blockchain / Tokenization Engineering Manager Director.


You will lead blockchain innovation, securing scalable DeFi solutions and shaping the future of decentralized finance.


Compensation:

USD 70K - 90K/year.


Location:

Remote (for residents of Brazil, Canada, and India).


Mission of RMD International Group:

\"At RIG Global Consulting, we stand out as the premier choice for startups and small businesses seeking professional, reliable, and compliant operations support without the burden of full-time executive hires.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +7 years experience in Software engineering.
  • You are proficient in IT project management, fintech development and Infrastructure as code (IaC)
  • English - Conversational


Responsibilities and more:

Blockchain / Tokenization Engineering Manager Director

Remote (for residents of Brazil, Canada, and India).

Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor.


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with the company’s goals.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices, including infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and automated testing.
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains.
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading is a plus.
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development.
  • Understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments.
  • Experience with modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD, and containerization.
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: SAP S/4HANA Functional Data Consultant/Lead
description:
We are hiring for our North America Client

Payment is USD ; Monthly Pay ; No Benefits

Candidate need to have 2 week notice period

Candidate need to have an excellent English communication skills

Candidate need to use their own laptop for work

Resume need to be shared in English format



7 months contract ; May extend

Remote role


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.


Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes.


This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.


The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.

• Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,Deliver, Return)


Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.


Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our HR team. This professional will be responsible for identifying and assessing the different profiles (Technical and Non-technical). We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handling multiple tasks, and with marked attention to detail. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Review online information of candidates to assess their general fit.

- Contact candidates through phone calls, Skype, LinkedIn, or mail to validate their interest and motivate them to participate in our process.

- Schedule internal interviews, send the invites, and keep the system records updated.

- Interview candidates to assess their qualifications by validating their profile, experience, interests, commitment, and logic and common sense questions.

- Schedule and confirm technical interviews.

- Follow up with the candidates throughout the process.

- Adapt to a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.


Requirements:


- 2+ previous years of work experience. Previous experience in recruiting roles is a plus.

- Good communication skills, especially in listening and persuasion.

- Time management and organization.

- Flexibility and adaptability to constant changes.

- Working experience in online and phone sales techniques (is a plus).

- Knowledge in IT Industry head-hunting (is a plus).

- Advanced English Level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Automation Engineer with Cypress
description:
Role: Automation Engineer with Cypress

Location: Remote Brazil

Long term contract


JD-;

• 5-8 years as a Test Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using tools like Cypress. You will work closely with development teams to design robust, scalable, and efficient test automation frameworks and strategies, ensuring that the products meet the highest standards of quality. Your role will be crucial in building and optimizing automated tests for web applications across various browsers and environments, focusing on continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

• Key Responsibilities:

• • Test Automation Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive test automation strategies, ensuring thorough coverage of both functional and non-functional testing requirements.

• • Automated Test Script Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, and other relevant tools, ensuring compatibility with various browsers and platforms.

• • Framework Development: Create and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks, incorporating best practices and design patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven, or Keyword-Driven frameworks.

• • Continuous Integration: Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI, ensuring automated tests run efficiently in every build and release.

• • Test Execution & Reporting: Execute automated tests in different environments and ensure they are executed with the correct data sets, logging, and reporting outcomes. Analyze test results and provide actionable insights.

• • Collaboration: Work closely with QA, DevOps, and Development teams to ensure seamless integration of test automation processes into the development lifecycle.

• • Bug Reporting & Tracking: Identify and report issues and bugs in the system, assisting development teams in reproducing and debugging issues.

• Required Skills & Qualifications:

• • Experience: hands-on experience in test automation with Selenium and Cypress, with a proven track record of successfully automating complex web applications.

• • Selenium Expertise: Strong expertise in Selenium WebDriver for automating functional tests, including experience with various browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, etc.).

• • Cypress Expertise: Proficiency in writing and maintaining tests using Cypress, including handling different testing needs like end-to-end, integration, and performance testing.

• • Test Automation Frameworks: Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining test automation frameworks using patterns like Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

• • Programming Languages: Strong coding skills in languages like Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.

• • Version Control: Proficient in using Git for source control and managing automation repositories.

• • Test Case Design & Reporting: Experience designing detailed test cases, test scripts, and generating clear and actionable test reports.

• Cross-Browser Testing: Experience with cross-browser testing and cross-platform compatibility in automated tests..

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Tech Lead .Net Sênior - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da vaga

-CLT + Benefícios

-Modelo de atuação: Remoto


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

1. Arquitetura e Decisões Técnicas

- Definir, evoluir e sustentar a arquitetura de sistemas baseados em .NET (.NET Core / .NET 6+), assegurando escalabilidade, resiliência e performance.

- Tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas envolvendo microsserviços, APIs, mensageria, cloud e integração entre sistemas.

- Avaliar e mitigar riscos técnicos, débito técnico e impactos de decisões arquiteturais no longo prazo.


2. Desenvolvimento Backend Avançado

title: SDR (Pré-Vendas) | Comercial – 100% Remoto (PJ)
description:
SDR (Pré-Vendas) | Comercial – 100% Remoto (PJ)

A Colmeia Mídias é uma agência especializada em performance para e-commerces , com metodologia validada em mais de 30 segmentos e foco em crescimento previsível e lucrativo.

Estamos em expansão e buscamos uma pessoa para atuar no time Comercial , sendo responsável pela geração, qualificação e agendamento de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades
  • Atender leads que chegam via tráfego pago (inbound)
  • Realizar o primeiro contato, entender o momento do negócio e alinhar expectativas
  • Qualificar leads e agendar reuniões para o closer realizar a venda
  • Executar prospecção ativa (outbound) com abordagens estratégicas
  • Realizar follow-ups e manter o CRM organizado
  • Seguir o processo comercial da Colmeia


Modelo de trabalho
  • Contratação PJ
  • 100% remoto
  • Trabalho orientado a resultado e performance


Remuneração
  • Fixo mensal inicial: R$ 1.500,00
  • Variável: 25% da primeira parcela de cada contrato fechado
  • Ticket médio dos contratos: ~R$ 4.000,00


Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Conforto com metas, indicadores e rotina comercial
  • Organização, constância e perfil proativo


Diferenciais
  • Experiência em agências de marketing
  • Vivência com vendas consultivas
  • Familiaridade com CRM
Não é necessário ter experiência prévia com e-commerce. O método é ensinado internamente.
Crescimento

Existe um caminho claro de evolução dentro da área comercial.

Profissionais que entregam resultado, dominam o processo e mantêm consistência podem assumir funções com mais responsabilidade e evolução financeira ao longo do tempo.


Contratação

Início imediato.

  • Candidate-se pela vaga. Entraremos em contato caso seu perfil faça sentido para o momento da Colmeia.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Executar testes manuais em aplicações web, mobile e APIs.
  • Criar e manter casos de teste e cenários de teste.
  • Realizar testes funcionais, regressão e smoke.
  • Testar APIs REST utilizando ferramentas como Postman ou Insomnia.
  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar bugs e melhorias.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas antes da publicação em produção.

  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados.

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Wellhub, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Senior Insurance Information Caller (English Required)(Remote – $4/hr)
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our team. The primary responsibilities include verifying health insurance coverage, analyzing data, and making calls to insurance companies to ensure accurate information is obtained. The role also involves reviewing and analyzing insurance codes from various providers and assessing the details of the coverage.

Verify health insurance coverage with multiple insurance providers


Analyze and interpret insurance data for accuracy

Assess and compare insurance coverage details to ensure compliance and accuracy

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail


Ability to communicate effectively with insurance companies


Familiarity with health insurance policies and coverage


Excellent organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple tasks


Fluent English

title: Junior Media Buyer
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re Nooro - a fast-growing app company operating alongside a highly profitable eCommerce business, doing over $100M per year. 


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented part-time Media Buyer to support our Meta Ads execution for e-commerce brands.


This role is execution-focused, not strategy-heavy. You’ll be responsible for building, launching, and organizing ads inside Meta Ads Manager according to clearly defined frameworks and naming conventions.


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


SCHEDULE & TIME COMMITMENT

• Thursdays & Fridays only (2:00 PM – 7:00 PM PST)

• 10–12 hours per week total

• Ongoing / long-term opportunity if it’s a good fit


RESPONSIBILITES

• Build and launch ads inside Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram)

• Follow strict naming conventions for campaigns, ad sets, and ads

• Set up campaigns accurately (CBO, ABO, ASC when applicable)

• QA ads before launch (copy, creative, links, tracking)

• Update and reference Google Sheets for ad tracking and organization

• Work closely with our internal team to ensure clean execution


REQUIREMENTS

• Minimum 2 years experience running Meta Ads for e-commerce brands

• Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign structure

• Comfortable working with Google Sheets

• Detail-oriented and organized (naming conventions matter)

• Able to work independently during assigned time blocks

• Fluent in English


NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

• Experience with high-spend or performance-driven accounts

• Familiarity with creative testing frameworks


This is a straightforward execution role with clear systems and expectations. We value precision, speed, and reliability.

title: SAP Basis Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em Follow The Sun (FTS) no suporte a incidentes para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo ambientes SAP RISE .
  • Garantir integridade, disponibilidade e controles das instâncias SAP em ambientes híbridos (on-prem + cloud).
  • Produzir relatórios e métricas para stakeholders, incluindo KPIs operacionais e SLAs de serviços em nuvem .
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas de grande porte que envolvam múltiplos times e ambientes SAP RISE e tradicionais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times EMIT , SAP e hyperscalers (AWS, Azure) para restauração de serviços em incidentes críticos.
  • Analisar requisitos técnicos para onboarding SAP RISE e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir documentação de padrões BASIS , incluindo arquiteturas SAP RISE e configurações específicas de cloud.
  • Construir e testar Proof of Concepts (PoCs) em ambientes SAP RISE e SAP BTP .
  • Executar atividades de administração de sistemas em:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP HANA Database
  • Implementar e manter monitoramento e alertas utilizando:
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP Cloud ALM
  • Realizar atividades recorrentes de manutenção, como:
  • RFCs
  • Perfis SAP
  • Limpeza de file systems
  • Login groups e load balancing
  • Atuar como owner na análise e resolução de problemas de plataforma , utilizando práticas estruturadas de problem management.
  • Planejar e executar:
  • Upgrades de sistemas
  • Enhancement Packs
  • Atualizações de serviços em nuvem
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura, incluindo DB, SO e hardware , em ambientes híbridos.
  • Monitorar capacidade (CPU, disco, spool, memória) em sistemas on-prem e cloud.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de performance , inclusive em ambientes SAP RISE.
  • Planejar e executar testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery , incluindo cenários de failover em nuvem.
  • Responder a relatórios EarlyWatch e health checks específicos do SAP RISE .
  • Gerenciar jobs de housekeeping e scripts de automação.
  • Atuar em plantões rotativos (on-call) fora do horário comercial.
  • Construir e configurar sistemas SAP seguindo padrões corporativos, incluindo provisionamento e onboarding SAP RISE .


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida com SAP BASIS , incluindo:
  • SAP NetWeaver ABAP e JAVA
  • SAP Solution Manager
  • SAP Focused Run
  • SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com SAP HANA , incluindo administração e otimização.
  • Vivência com SAP RISE , incluindo:
  • Provisionamento em cloud
  • SLAs
  • Integração com hyperscalers
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos SAP (on-premises + cloud).
  • Conhecimentos em SAP BTP e SAP Cloud ALM .
  • Experiência com scripts e automação (PowerShell, Shell Script).
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , documentação e comunicação técnica.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes SAP de grande porte e alta criticidade.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas complexas e globais .
  • Experiência em automação e padronização de ambientes SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

Responsabilidades:

title: Analista de Dados & Financeiro
description:
Analista de Dados & Financeiro – Proposta de Cargo

Missão do Cargo

Dar sustentação técnica e operacional nas rotinas de análise, integração e consolidação financeira da XMX — garantindo a rastreabilidade e precisão dos dados que alimentam a DRE, o fluxo de caixa e as decisões estratégicas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Controle e Consolidação Financeira

  • Apoiar na consolidação das DREs, segmentadas por lojas e plataformas de venda;
  • Atualizar e validar planilhas de CMV, CPA, taxas de reembolso e chargeback;
  • Auxiliar na criação de rotinas de fechamento semanal e mensal (competência e caixa).

2. Análise e Automação de Dados

  • Manipular grandes volumes de dados (Excel, Sheets, CSV) para estruturação de dashboards voltados para tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  • Automatização de planilhas e relatórios;
  • Executar tarefas de auditoria técnica (checagem entre fontes, variações, erros).

3. Suporte ao Backend Financeiro

  • Auxiliar no cruzamento entre dados operacionais e resultados financeiros;
  • Atualizar indicadores de LTV, churn, taxa de reembolso e lucro por lead;
  • Preparar insumos para negociações com fornecedores;


Perfil ideal

  • Domínio do Excel/Sheets como ferramenta de trabalho;
  • Comunicação clara, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de execução autônoma;
  • Resiliente sob pressão — ambiente dinâmico, com demandas simultâneas de diversas áreas;
  • Entendimento prático de DRE, fluxo de caixa, CMV, margem, ROI, CPA.
  • Ter entendimento de estatística financeira

  • Apoiar na consolidação das DREs, segmentadas por lojas e plataformas de venda;
  • Atualizar e validar planilhas de CMV, CPA, taxas de reembolso e chargeback;
  • Auxiliar na criação de rotinas de fechamento semanal e mensal (competência e caixa).

2. Análise e Automação de Dados

  • Manipular grandes volumes de dados (Excel, Sheets, CSV) para estruturação de dashboards voltados para tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  • Automatização de planilhas e relatórios;
  • Executar tarefas de auditoria técnica (checagem entre fontes, variações, erros).

3. Suporte ao Backend Financeiro

  • Auxiliar no cruzamento entre dados operacionais e resultados financeiros;
  • Atualizar indicadores de LTV, churn, taxa de reembolso e lucro por lead;
  • Preparar insumos para negociações com fornecedores;


Perfil ideal

  • Domínio do Excel/Sheets como ferramenta de trabalho;
  • Comunicação clara, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de execução autônoma;
  • Resiliente sob pressão — ambiente dinâmico, com demandas simultâneas de diversas áreas;
  • Entendimento prático de DRE, fluxo de caixa, CMV, margem, ROI, CPA.
  • Ter entendimento de estatística financeira

title: English Communty Leader Program (Remote)
description:
About Fondi

Fondi is a global English learning platform focused on conversation-based learning through live events and communities. We are looking for ESL tutors who want to go beyond teaching and grow their own English-speaking community.


Role description

As a Community Leader, you will build and grow an English learning community by hosting engaging events and guiding members to actively practice speaking in a supportive environment.


Responsibilities

  • Host English conversation events and community activities
  • Build and grow an active learner community
  • Create simple, engaging speaking activities
  • Guide trial members and support their learning journey
  • Work with the Fondi team to improve engagement and retention
  • Maintain consistency in hosting and community interaction


Incentives

  • Incentive-based earnings tied to activity and achievement
  • Rewards based on event consistency, community growth, and engagement
  • Opportunities to unlock higher incentives and VIP-level hosting
  • Personal brand exposure as a global community leader


Requirements

  • ESL tutor or English instructor of English Major Graduated welcome to apply
  • Confident spoken English
  • Comfortable hosting live sessions and leading discussions
  • Interest in community building and learner engagement
  • Reliable and proactive attitude

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager (LATAM Recruitment Focus)

Location: Remote

Region Focus: Brazil


About the Role:

We are looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) with a strong background in end-to-end recruitment and a proven ability to bring in new clients, particularly in the LATAM region. The ideal candidate understands both the business side of staffing and the recruitment life cycle, making them a key player in driving growth and delivery.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and develop new client relationships across the LATAM region (Mexico, Brazil, Argentina).
  • Pitch staffing/recruitment services to potential clients and close deals.
  • Collaborate with internal recruiting teams to deliver qualified candidates for open roles.
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle for LATAM-based candidates—from sourcing to on boarding.
  • Understand and adapt to regional labor markets, client needs, and cultural dynamics.
  • Track business development efforts using CRM tools and report on progress.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in business development or sales within the staffing/recruiting industry.
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment, especially for LATAM candidates.
  • Strong client network or ability to generate leads in Mexico, Brazil, and Argentina.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and drive results.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with international or remote teams.
  • Existing book of business or access to potential clients in LATAM.
  • Familiarity with global hiring platforms and CRM/recruitment tools.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Company Overview:

We are a rapidly growing company specializing in Editing Content services. Our high-intent prospects mean we need motivated and detail-oriented individuals to coach our clients on how to navigate the idea creation and maintaining relationships. If you're experienced in a client success role and sales/influence and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want you to join our dynamic team.


Position: Full-Time Client Success

Location: Remote (Work From Home)


Hours: Monday to Friday, 9AM - 5PM or 11 AM to 7PM Eastern Time Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive commissions

• On-Target Earnings (OTE)

• Performance-based incentives

• Clear structure with defined goals

• Opportunity for growth with a competitive pay structure

• Work-from-home flexibility


Key Responsibilities:

• Onboard clients with ideation calls to get them excited about the process

• Make sure all clients are happy and always checking up on them

• Follow up with clients to ensure they are enjoying their experience

• Manage multiple clients in a fast-paced environment

• Consistently meet performance metrics related to sales and marketing


Requirements:

• Experience in a client success and sales role

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and performance-driven environment

• Proven track record of being in sales and in a client success role


If you are a results-driven individual with sales and customer success experience, we'd love to hear from you!


How to Apply:

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities:

• Manage large-scale Cloud transformation and migration projects within the cloud practice.

• Prepare, track, and manage project schedules, ensuring timely delivery.

• Drive project/program management activities across multiple cloud consulting and migration initiatives. • Collaborate with stakeholders including clients, offshore teams, and cross-functional groups to deliver transformation goals.

• Oversee governance, project status reporting, and cadence reviews with leadership and internal stakeholders. • Identify, track, and resolve issues, risks, and escalations across projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, and aligned with organizational objectives.


Must Have Skills:

✔ 15+ years of experience in cloud transformation, migration, and consulting projects (Competency C5/C6).

✔ Proven track record in executing large-scale Cloud Migrations (SQL, Windows, App Services, AVS, AVD).

✔ Strong background in Infrastructure (Virtualization, Cloud technologies, compute, storage, networking).

✔ Expertise in planning and managing multiple stakeholders.

✔ Experience with DC migration to Cloud.

✔ Strong problem-solving, time management, and organizational skills.

✔ Ability to handle tight deadlines and escalations effectively.


Good to Have:

  • Certifications: Agile Management, PRINCE2/PMP (Preferred), other program management certifications.
  • Tools & Technologies: ADO or other project management tools, Azure Cloud, Databases, Networking, Virtualization, Public Cloud.


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Support Coordinator
description:
Job Description

Pay: USD $1,400 / month

Hours: Monday-Friday 9 am to 5 pm EST

Contract: Full‑time Remote

Non-negotiable Requirement: Advanced English


Ready to Apply? We value thoughtful applications over quick submissions. Please send a short introduction video to Include any relevant experience or examples of your work that demonstrate your skills.


Alternatively, you will receive an automated email to prepare a one-way video interview as the first step of the hiring process. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for customer KPI’s and ensuring we are meeting our response promises
  • Resolution of all tickets that flow through our Help Desk for all departments
  • Responsible for live chat, email and phone support
  • Enforcing SLA times with all departments
  • Management of our Help Desk and Knowledge Base
  • Assisting with the development of our CRM by working with the Product Owner team
  • Collecting enhancement requirements from our franchisees and working with the Product Owner team for implementation
  • Responsible for documentation of IT releases and training through webinars and video tutorials
  • Collaborating with the Field Support Team to execute pre- and post-call responsibilities for the weekly Global Team Call
  • Create reports as a result of data supplied on a weekly basis
  • Responsible for leading and coordinating the weekly Company Huddles
  • Other administrative/support/ assistance as required


EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

  • 1-2 years experience with Help Desk support
  • Superior communication skills written and oral
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Very good organizational and priority-setting skills
  • Exceptional collaboration and teamwork skills
  • Passionately focused on driving projects & customer success
  • Open-minded, teachable, dedicated to excellence, driven, creative and organized
  • Able to multi-task and work on various projects and meet strict deadlines
  • Must have a positive “can-do\" attitude
  • Must be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Consultor de SAP MM Especialista
description:
A Verus Brasil, especializada em soluções SAP e TI, está com oportunidade em aberto para:


ESPECIALISTA SAP MM - GOVERNAÇA EM ENTRADAS PROCESSO INBOUND / IS-OIL INDUSTRIES

⌛ Período: 02 meses, com perspectiva de prorrogação;

Modelo de Trabalho: REMOTO - Disponibilidade para viagens a Manaus.

Previsão de Início: Imediato

Requisitos

Forte conhecimento de Oil & Gas

Conhecimento de sistemas fiscais, ao menos Onesource e Taxone

Domínio de DRC, módulos que compõem, integrações de consultorias em geral

Domínio de Inbound - SAP, mas com capacidade de gerar comparações com outras ferramentas de inbound além da SAP;

Forte conhecimento de TAXBRJ e TAXBRA e visão disto com relação a Oil & Gas

Forte conhecimento de todos os processos de MM (Contratos, Programa de Remessa, Entrada Fiscal, Movimentação de estoque, Cenários de Entrada, Subcontratação, estoque flutuante, etc), particularmente estes cenários conectados com Oil & Gas e principalmente Manaus

Forte capacidade de entender, mapear, e interagir com visão de processos

Conhecimento de TM e entendimento com CTe e Frete

Entender estes cenários para diferentes grupos de negocio (Distribuição, transportadora, refino)

Ter visão de integração destes processos com SD e CO

Entender ou conhecer o BPractices 4XB (Primary Distribution) e 4X8 (Secondary); 4XA – Asset Decommissioning

Entender de sistemas de COMEX e poder sugerir opções

Entender do BRF+, principalmente para IVA Automático

Entender do TSW

MRP para Oil com Bulk Distribution Requirements Planning (BDRP):

Entender o impacto de calculo de custo com Media Movel ou STD nos processos de OIL por empresas.


Sobre a empresa

A Verus Brasil é uma empresa especializada em soluções SAP, com uma trajetória marcada pela inovação e excelência. Fomos pioneiros no Brasil ao lançar o serviço AMS SAP e introduzimos a modalidade \"On demand\" para Atendimento a Melhorias SAP.


Como Parceiro Oficial SAP, temos o orgulho de oferecer serviços certificados, incluindo a Certificação SAP Business Suite Solutions Operations e o Selo de Reconhecimento SAP (SAP REX) em GRC, sendo o 1º da América Latina a receber essa distinção.


Nosso time é composto por profissionais certificados em SAP, PMI e ITIL, garantindo uma abordagem de alta qualidade em projetos, suporte e demandas SAP, tanto no Brasil quanto no exterior. Somos reconhecidos pela flexibilidade e equilíbrio na condução dos serviços e projetos contratados.


A Verus oferece um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, ideal para profissionais que desejam atuar em projetos inovadores em tecnologia e processos. A Verus busca desenvolver projetos que transformam o mercado e fazem a diferença para os clientes.


Se você está em busca de oportunidades que propiciam inovação e desenvolvimento, a Verus Brasil é o lugar certo.


Caso tenha interesse é só se candidatar na vaga ou enviar o CV diretamente ao email

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency

title: Head of Performance Marketing
description:
About Thunderly Marketing

At Thunderly Marketing, we focus on measurable business results, not vanity metrics. We partner closely with clients to drive revenue through smart media buying, creative testing, and continuous optimization. Our culture is built on ownership, transparency, experimentation, and high performance standards.

Responsibilities

As Head of Performance Marketing, you will:

  • Own the overall performance marketing strategy across all client accounts
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of performance marketers
  • Develop frameworks, SOPs, and best practices for campaign execution
  • Oversee budgets, forecasting, and core KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CAC, LTV)
  • Drive testing roadmaps across creatives, audiences, and funnels
  • Ensure high-quality reporting and client communication standards
  • Collaborate with creative, CRO, and analytics teams
  • Identify new growth opportunities and emerging platforms
  • Support sales and onboarding with strategic input
  • Act as senior performance advisor for key client accounts
Requirements
  • 6+ years of experience in performance marketing
  • Proven leadership experience managing paid media teams
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms
  • Strong strategic mindset with data-first decision making
  • Track record of scaling ad budgets profitably
  • Agency experience preferred
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable in fast-paced, remote or hybrid environments
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary and performance incentives
  • Remote or hybrid working model
  • Leadership role with real impact on company growth
  • Opportunity to build and shape a department
  • Clear executive career path
  • Collaborative, performance-driven culture
  • Learning and development budge
